result.title: Aqua2CAD : Observation-Guided Point Cloud Correction and Completion for CAD Reconstruction from Underwater Stereo Images
result.summary: Recovering editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from underwater stereo images requires accurate and complete geometry, yet stereo reconstruction produces displaced points and missing regions. The original views retain cross-view disagreement and ray evidence lost during point-cloud fusion. Aqua2CAD exploits this evidence in two stages: view-conditioned correction and quality filtering establish reliable geometric support, while multi-view observations condition a learned shape prior to infer missing surfaces in the original metric frame. The recovered points support surface fitting and solid assembly with manually revised face groups. On an OceanSim-based synthetic benchmark, Aqua2CAD reduces point-cloud Chamfer distance by 60% relative to the stereo reconstruction. Compared with a matched point-only completion backbone, it improves missing-region recovery at 5,mm from 16.27% to 24.16%. With a shared CAD backend, exterior acceptance increases from 6/19 to 14/19. Qualitative results on selected real underwater captures demonstrate recovery of the main structures of six 3D-printed objects.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向水下双目图像的可编辑 CAD 重建，提出两阶段流程：先用视角条件校正与质量过滤建立可靠几何支撑，再以多视角观测约束学习到的形状先验来补全缺失表面，并接表面拟合与实体装配。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作核心是三维点云的几何修复与 CAD 重建，未涉及 VLM 内部推理状态、latent 表示或答案对视觉证据的使用；跨视角不一致只作为几何校正线索，与 LVR 的状态更新和证据筛选问题联系过弱。
